name: vm_identity_q1_b0_ref-identity2-COMMIT
purpose: Source-specialized bank from actual literal quadrant/slice identity; identity ports and FFs removed, no static-input timing waiver. CE status gains one registered carry edge; data calendars unchanged. Die grant r2: every bit on an actual M4/M5 track, M5 centres clear of PG stripe projections (q1 identity1 gate: 3068 off-track centres + 95 PG projections), placed by the shared exact-pin helper; actual ODB coordinate/track/PG readback. Diagnostic child only; no parent/die binding or physical qualification claimed.
